sources.entry: Supermaven - Fast AI code completion with 300k token context window. #freemium

summary.name: Supermaven
summary.one_liner: Supermaven is an AI code completion tool that suggests code using a large context window of the surrounding codebase.
use_cases: writing code faster with inline suggestions
getting completions that respect types defined elsewhere in a project
autocompleting code in a large codebase
summary.what_it_does: Supermaven provides AI code completions while you type, described as the fastest copilot on the page. The page says it uses a 1 million token context window to improve suggestion quality. In the example shown, it finds the definition of a type (PostMetadata) elsewhere in the codebase and uses it to produce correct suggestions. The page text gives no details on supported editors or languages beyond the code example, which is TypeScript. The listing describes it as having a 300k token context window, which differs from the 1 million figure on the page itself.
notable: Uses a 1 million token context window on the page (listing says 300k)
Finds definitions elsewhere in the codebase to inform suggestions
Marketed as a fast alternative to Copilot-style tools
caveats: Platforms and supported editors are not named in the page text
Context window size differs between the page (1M tokens) and the listing (300k tokens)
